checks.name: Empty initialization and restart preserve the workspace identity and bytes
Create and readonly detail preserve exact source whitespace without exposing hashes
Accepted creation retries reuse one record without another write
Reused request IDs reject changed bodies and changed keys
Invalid content, labels, enums and weak new capabilities do not write
Update advances one version and protects against stale edits
Incorrect capabilities cannot update or delete
Deletion preserves receipt so an old create request cannot resurrect content
Expired records are hidden without purge and can be deleted with their capability
Keep expiry does not silently renew a paste during editing
Search is literal, public-only, paginated and returns bounded previews
Unlisted links remain directly readable and never appear in public results
Independent store instances serialize simultaneous writes without losing records
Concurrent same-version edits accept exactly one winner
Malformed active JSON stops startup without resetting the file
Null, duplicate, unknown and missing persisted fields are rejected
Missing active data during operation is not mistaken for a fresh workspace
Oversized storage is rejected before loading or replacing it
A failed replacement preserves previously accepted bytes
Rejected domain mutation and cancellation do not leak in-memory changes to disk
Replay callbacks cannot silently change data and writes must advance one revision
Existing legacy records require explicit migration before startup
Reviewed legacy migration preserves source bytes, views, content and older capabilities
Migration refuses existing workspaces and malformed legacy records
UTF-8 BOM and empty legacy collections migrate without adding sample records
Paste count capacity rejects the next create without dropping earlier records
Receipt capacity preserves idempotency history instead of pruning it
Activity capacity rejects further changes without losing audit history
Encoded aggregate size is bounded before the active file is replaced
Concurrent independent processes cannot overwrite each other's accepted creates
